description: The bar chart, titled "Rethinking Repetition Problems of LLMs in Code Generation," illustrates the performance of four different language models—RPG (CodeLlama-7B), RPG (CodeLlama-34B), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B)—across four distinct metrics: EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The vertical axis represents performance, scaled from 0.0 to 1.0, while the horizontal axis lists the metrics. Each metric has a group of four bars, colored blue, orange, green, and red, corresponding to the models listed in the legend. For the EGP metric, the orange bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is the tallest, reaching a performance of approximately 0.9, followed by the red bar (RPG (CodeLlama-34B)) at about 0.95. The green bar (Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)) is at approximately 0.6, and the blue bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is the shortest, near 0.0. In the TR-N metric, the blue bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is the tallest, at about 0.7, followed by the green bar (Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)) at approximately 0.6. The orange bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is at about 0.45, and the red bar (RPG (CodeLlama-34B)) is at about 0.4. For the TR-S metric, the blue bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is the tallest, at about 0.7, followed by the green bar (Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)) at approximately 0.45. The orange bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is at about 0.4, and the red bar (RPG (CodeLlama-34B)) is at about 0.3. In the CCP metric, the red bar (RPG (CodeLlama-34B)) is the tallest, at about 0.95, followed by the orange bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) at approximately 0.72. The green bar (Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)) is at about 0.7, and the blue bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is at about 0.4. The chart includes upward and downward arrows next to the EGP and TR-N/ TR-S metrics, respectively, indicating the direction of improvement.
